purpose: Execute an already-valid capability-bound dispatch through host-native subagents while preserving deterministic gates, receipts, and closeout evidence.
invariants: No action is emitted from an invalid dispatch.
No native subagent is spawned before execution authorization is satisfied.
A non-pass or missing required receipt withholds every dependent action.
The runner never substitutes a nested model-backed CLI for a missing host-native tool.
Every host action is recorded when it is attempted, not reconstructed after the run.
Historical evidence is not rewritten to manufacture integration proof.

components.responsibility: Invoke the canonical Dispatch Spec validator and normalize its receipt.
Compile the next permitted actions from the dispatch and current state.
Reduce native action receipts into the next state and gate decision.
Perform only the spawn, join, message, and close actions emitted by the coordinator.
Append action events and materialize run, receipt, gate, and closeout artifacts.

actions.spawn: Create exactly one native agent for an eligible role and record its host identifier.
actions.wait: Wait for the selected active agents without changing route authority.
actions.join: Collect a completed agent result and bind it to its declared role and step.
actions.close: Close or interrupt an agent under the dispatch join policy.
actions.block: Stop dependent execution and emit the blocking evidence.
actions.complete: Validate closeout and finish the run.

acceptance_scenarios.expected: A non-pass first-wave receipt produces a blocking gate and zero dependent spawns.
All passing first-wave receipts open the gate and each dependent role is spawned exactly once.

non_goals: Changing Dispatch Spec into an execution engine.
Claiming native host parity before host-specific canaries pass.
Migrating every legacy model-backed CLI call in the same work pack.
